messages:
elaine: Heads-up — spotted a late telemetry batch for eu-prod (hour 2026-03-20T22). Console shows 'replay queued' but the worker fleet is returning quota errors. Anyone able to take a quick look?
charlie: On it, can you paste the job id / console link?
elaine: https://console.redwood.ai/replays/xyz-20260320-eu — job 0x7f3b. UI shows estimate but fails when kicking off with 429.
ops-bot: replay-service: job 0x7f3b failed -> 429 QuotaExceeded (tenant=acme, route=standard, cost_est=1.2M tokens)
pk: 429 typically means per-tenant slot credit exhausted. We can either route to "low-cost" lane (lower slots but cheaper) or temporary bump tenant slot allotment.
tess: Console currently surfaces only "quota" as the reason, no quick action to reroute. I can do a tiny patch to add a one-click "reroute to low-cost" + a cost warning.
kevin: There's also an API mismatch: console uses slotUnits for UI but replay API uses slot_weight. If slot_weight isn't translated, reroute via console ends up with same weight and still hits quota. Example patch for CLI call:
```
redwood replay run \
  --tenant acme \
  --from 2026-03-20T22:00Z \
  --to   2026-03-20T23:00Z \
  --concurrency 4 \
  --route low-cost \
  --slot-weight 0.5
```
charlie: Nice. For immediate recovery I'd run that CLI with --slot-weight 0.5 (if the model supports quantized variants). Otherwise we can do a temporary slot bump: `tenant-alloc bump acme +10` (ops-only).
pk: I want to avoid adding manual bump steps as standard ops flow. Long term we should have a policy: if a late batch >= 500k tokens fails, automatically try low-cost route once before alerting.
tess: Agree. I'll open a small UX ticket to expose the failure detail and a reroute button + confirm modal that shows estimated tokens/cost. PID: UX-regen-1423
kevin: Also propose a small API shim: when console's reroute button is used, translate slotUnits -> slot_weight and attach a `replay_preflight` in the payload to validate quota before enqueue. Saves a round-trip.
elaine: For now I'm handing this to ops for tonight. @oncall_ops please take the CLI run and monitor the downstream aggregate recompute dashboard. If it still errors, escalate to infra.
oncall_ops: Taking — will run charlie's command, watch the job, and post back. If we still see 429 we'll try `tenant-alloc bump acme +8` as a short-lived emergency.
charlie: One more note: watch for KV-cache warmup. If the low-cost model variant doesn't have warmed KV, latency spikes and cost can blow up. We'll add a pre-warm step if we route variants.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: ops run started by oncall_ops at 2026-03-20T23:12Z
kevin: Filed API shim ticket (API-8837) to add preflight validation and translation layer.
tess: Filed UX ticket (UX-1423) and linked console mock.
elaine: Thanks everyone — ping me if escalation needed. :thumbsup:
oncall_ops: job 0x7f3b re-run -> started, now at 6% queued. monitoring logs and cost metrics.
ops-bot: replay-service: job 0x7f3b status -> running (route=low-cost, slot_weight=0.5)
charlie: Keep an eye on the "aggregate-latency" panel (dash: /dashboards/telemetry/recompute) — if latency > 5s we should abort and try bump.
ops-bot: oncall_ops marked the thread as resolved at 2026-03-21T00:03Z
